# Function: unstable\_getAffinityHeaders()

> **unstable\_getAffinityHeaders**(`options`): [`Promise`](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Promise)\<[`Record`](https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/utility-types.html#recordkeys-type)\<`string`, `string`\>\>

Defined in: [packages/functions/src/affinity.ts:75](https://github.com/vercel/vercel/blob/main/packages/functions/src/affinity.ts#L75)

**`Experimental`**

Returns request headers for invoking a Vercel Function with an explicit
affinity ID. Set `oidc: true` to include the current project's OIDC token;
service-binding URLs authenticate independently.

This is an experimental API and may change without notice.

The returned object can be passed to `fetch` or another HTTP client, or
combined with other headers. Enable OIDC only for functions you intend to
receive the project's token, and avoid forwarding it through redirects to
untrusted destinations.

## Parameters

### options

[`GetAffinityHeadersOptions`](../type-aliases/GetAffinityHeadersOptions.md)

The required affinity ID and optional OIDC setting.

## Returns

[`Promise`](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Promise)\<[`Record`](https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/utility-types.html#recordkeys-type)\<`string`, `string`\>\>

A plain object containing `x-vercel-affinity-id` and, when enabled,
`x-vercel-trusted-oidc-idp-token`.

## Example

```js
import { unstable_getAffinityHeaders } from '@vercel/functions';

const headers = await unstable_getAffinityHeaders({
  affinityId: 'room:123',
  oidc: true,
});

const response = await fetch('https://my-project.vercel.app/api/actor', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { ...headers, 'content-type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ action: 'join' }),
  redirect: 'error',
});
```
